o.norm: Unable to obtain LocalDate from TemporalAccessor: DayOfMonth:14 of type org.threeten.extra.DayOfMonth

i.norm: A {@link DayOfMonth} only carries a day value; it has no full date information and is not tied to the ISO chronology in a way the Minguo calendar can use. Asking {@code MinguoDate.from(...)} to build a date from it must therefore fail: internally it tries to obtain a {@code LocalDate} from the DayOfMonth and cannot, so a {@link DateTimeException} is raised from {@code java.time.LocalDate}.
"Unable to obtain LocalDate from TemporalAccessor: DayOfMonth:.. of type org.threeten.extra.DayOfMonth"
